item.title: As ice receded on a Swiss Alpine pass, archaeologists discovered a 4,000 years old bronze neck ring
item.description: A remarkable discovery at Lötschen Pass has unearthed a 4,000-year-old bronze neck ring, making it the first metal artifact found at this significant historical site. While previous discoveries were primarily organic materials preserved in ice, this find suggests that ancient peoples may have practiced mobility through Alpine passes, connecting various regions. Experts speculate that the ring could have served as a ritual offering or token of gratitude. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: 'Worst Ever' COP Summit?
item.description: Is this the worst COP summit on record? With limited political leadership, no official US delegation and mounting frustration over bureaucratic delays, questions are being raised about the effectiveness of the climate negotiations. Juan Carlos Beldsoe, a former White House climate adviser under Bill Clinton, described the process as labyrinthine and ultimately dispiriting. France 24's Gavin Lee speaks with climate advocate and six-time COP delegate, Henna Hundal about what this means for the future of global climate action. Fuente: France 24 - English.
